dedupe_keys.name: data from analysis and prediction of effects of the manchester triage system on patient waiting times in an emergency department by means of agent based simulation

description: This deposit contains a SeSAm agent-based emergency-department simulation and a separate README, published by Michael Schaaf and colleagues to examine the Manchester Triage System. The documented model implements four agent classes and an optional triage nurse. Patient volume and staffing can be varied to compare waiting times across severity levels. The study concerns a German emergency-department process; the deposit was published in 2014, while the observation dates and temporal resolution are not stated in the landing-page metadata. Zenodo provides Simulation.zip and a PDF README under CC0, free of charge. The archive was not downloaded or executed, so present-day SeSAm compatibility remains unknown. This resource can support hospital-capacity scenarios and comparisons of triage policies. It is a runnable-model candidate, not a patient-demand reference series; no related catalogue record is identified by the deposit.
